Key issues: ip should be uni_owns, publication reviewDays 60 is acceptable, exclusivity 24 months is max. I need to change ip to uni_owns_option_to_licence and reduce exclusivity months. I can trade on exclusivity (keep 24) to get ip changed, or trade reviewDays.

I'll propose uni_owns_option_to_licence and reduce exclusivity to 18 months, keeping reviewDays at 60.

Wait, I can only change at most two fields. Let me change ip and exclusivity months.
